question_text: A 20L disinfectant has 30% bleach. How many L of pure bleach to add for 50% bleach?

hint_ladder.title: Current Bleach
hint_ladder.text: Currently, 30% of 20 L is bleach: 0.30 × 20 = 6 L of pure bleach.

hint_ladder.title: Let x=added bleach
hint_ladder.text: After adding x L of pure bleach, total bleach = 6 + x, total volume = 20 + x. We want (6+x)/(20+x) = 0.50.

hint_ladder.title: Solve
hint_ladder.text: Multiply both sides by (20+x): 6+x = 10 + 0.5x → subtract 0.5x: 0.5x = 4 → x = 8.

hint_ladder.title: Answer
hint_ladder.text: You need to add 8 L of pure bleach. Check: (6+8)/(20+8) = 14/28 = 0.50. Option C.

A.text: You might have chosen A because you took 20% of 20L, forgetting the volume increase and ignoring the existing bleach.

B.text: You might have chosen B because you simply added the current bleach amount (6L) without accounting for the new total volume.

C.text: Correct. Adding 8L of pure bleach yields 14L bleach in 28L total, exactly 50% concentration.

D.text: You might have chosen D because you took 50% of 20L as 10L and added that, ignoring the existing bleach.

next_time_rule: **Key Takeaway:** For mixture problems, set up (pure amount)/(total volume) = target concentration. Let x be the added pure substance.
deconstruct_text:
Sa barangay health center, si Kuya Jun ay naghahanda ng mas matapang na bleach solution (50%) mula sa 20L na 30% bleach. Kailangan niyang malaman kung ilang litro ng pure bleach ang idadagdag.

Unahin ang kasalukuyang bleach: 30% ng 20L = 6L pure bleach. Hayaan ang idadagdag na pure bleach ay x liters. Pagkatapos magdagdag, ang kabuuang bleach = 6 + x, at kabuuang volume = 20 + x.

Gamitin ang desired concentration: (6 + x) / (20 + x) = 0.50. I-multiply both sides by (20+x): 6 + x = 10 + 0.5x. I-subtract ang 0.5x: 0.5x = 4. x = 8 liters. Kaya 8L ang kailangan.

**Watch-Out Zone: wrong base %** in action: using 20L as base ignores added volume.

**Mental Trick (Pinoy Style):** 'Pagdagdag ng pure substance, tandaan ang (Original + Add) / (Total + Add). Parang paglalagay ng asukal sa kapeng walang halo—mag-iiba ang tamis at dami!'
